title: IMF说透：人民币升值，关键不在汇率
speaker: Marshall Mills

segments.en: Well, so the core source of the imbalances is weak domestic demand in China.
segments.zh: 嗯，失衡的核心来源是中国内需偏弱。

segments.en: We see that internally in low inflation, and that leads to external imbalances.
segments.zh: 我们在内部看到低通胀，这导致外部失衡。

segments.en: And we do agree that the external imbalances, which for shorthand you could look at the current
segments.zh: 我们确实同意，外部失衡，简而言之可以看经常

segments.en: account surplus, that these are excessive, and that it's an everyone's interest to rein
segments.zh: 账户盈余，这些是过度的，控制这些符合所有人利益，

segments.en: So the first step is to boost domestic demand, as I mentioned earlier, stimulus.
segments.zh: 所以第一步是提振内需，正如我之前提到的，刺激。

segments.en: And we believe that this would have the impact, the effect of favoring appreciation.
segments.zh: 我们认为这会产生有利于升值的影响。

segments.en: So then the market would start moving towards appreciation.
segments.zh: 然后市场会开始走向升值。

segments.en: And we've always said that China should allow more flexibility in both directions, and in
segments.zh: 我们一直说中国应该允许双向更多灵活性，在

segments.en: this case, it would be more appreciation.
segments.zh: 这种情况下，将是更多升值。

segments.en: And that would contribute to lessening these external imbalances.
segments.zh: 这将有助于减少这些外部失衡。
